session.coach_note: The session for Thursday, 28 May, has been changed from an Easy Run to a Full Body Strength (Lighter) session as requested. This session prioritizes compound movements with lighter loads and higher reps to align with the 'lighter' full-body principle and manage fatigue during your marathon build. Weights are suggested at 70-80% of estimated 1RM to ensure RIR 3. This structure allows for lower body recovery before your long run on Saturday, while still providing a strength stimulus. Remember to prioritize sleep and adjust to the short_version if needed.
